summary: Iteration 8: tested the weekly summary cron, purchase expenses, suggested price, Suppliers and the WhatsApp order list on both backend and frontend. Backend: 8 of 9 new tests passed, and the iteration 6/7/exports regression run passed 23 of 23 after one outdated assertion was updated. The weekly cron rejects requests with no token or a wrong token (401). It accepted one call with the correct token and X-Webhook-Id, returned duplicate on the repeat, and stored a weekly/cron/sent delivery record. This sent exactly ONE real email. Purchase flow via API: amount auto-filled to 6500, stock went 1→11, unit_cost updated to 650, an 'Alış · Et' movement was logged, recipe cost went 90→97.5, PUT with amount 0 changed stock to 6, and DELETE brought it back to 1. UI: the full flow works, including Suppliers CRUD, the inventory supplier select, the purchase editor and its total, the product card suggested price (65% default and a custom 50%), and the order list WhatsApp href and phone. ONE BUG: editing a purchase expense in the UI does not recompute the amount.

minor.issue: _purchase_total only fills amount when amount == 0. When a purchase expense is edited, the frontend sends the existing amount (6500) again. After the quantity changes 10→5, stock becomes 6 but amount stays 6500 instead of 3250, so reports and cash expenses are overstated. Reproduced through the UI and the API (test_edit_with_stale_amount_keeps_old_amount).

PurchaseItem quantity and unit_price are not validated. Negative or zero values are accepted, and a negative quantity would lower stock. Also, deleting or reversing a purchase does not restore the previous unit_cost. That may be acceptable, but it is not documented.

ui_bugs.issue: On edit, the amount field is prefilled with the old auto-computed total, so changing purchase rows never updates the amount. Fix: on the backend, always recompute when the old amount equaled the old purchase total. Or on the frontend, track whether the amount was auto-computed and clear or sync it.

issues: When a supplier is deleted, inventory rows keep the orphaned supplier name. In the edit modal the select then shows 'Seçin', so saving the item silently clears its supplier.

action_items: Fix the stale amount on purchase expense edit. For example, in update_item for expenses, recompute amount when old amount == old purchase total or when amount is 0, or have the frontend clear amount when it was auto-computed.
Optional: validate PurchaseItem quantity > 0 and unit_price >= 0 (Field(gt=0) / Field(ge=0)).
Optional: handle inventory supplier names that no longer match a supplier (show them in the select or warn).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is only 44 lines, but the lines are extremely long (single-line components such as saveEntry, fieldsFor, Overview and ListView). It is unreadable and hard to diff. Split it into components/files.
apply_purchases calls recompute_product_costs on every expense create, update and delete, plus apply_moves logging per item. This is fine at this scale.
Order list now excludes items with suggested == 0 (an earlier recommendation was implemented). The iteration 7 test was updated to match.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; the stale amount on edit is the only defect)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. Every TEST_ record was deleted by id/name. stock_movements for deleted inventory (92) and my cron_run TEST_weekly_* were removed. 1 new report_deliveries record (weekly, cron, sent) was kept as instructed. The DB was NOT empty at start: Köfte (product), Kasap Ali (supplier), Dana kıyma (inventory) and their 3 stock_movements were created at 14:34 by someone else, likely the main agent's self-test. They were left untouched.
